name: Graylog
description: Searches Graylog (5, 6 and 7) with an access token: a panel to search and read logs with any of Graylog's fields as columns, a trend chart of messages over time (split by level, source or any field; drag to zoom), saved searches one click away, and tools that let the assistant search, count and follow trends.

settings.title: Graylog address
settings.description: The address you open Graylog at, e.g. https://graylog.example.com

settings.title: Default fields
settings.description: The columns shown until you pick others in the pane (Fields), comma separated.

secrets.title: Access token
secrets.description: Graylog › your profile › Edit tokens. Stored encrypted.
